turns.text: Create a silent 9-second 16:9 ad for my fictional planning app DayNest. Three equal-length scenes with these exact lines, one per scene in this order: 'Less scrolling. More doing.' / 'Plan your day in one place.' / 'Try DayNest today.' Keep capitals and punctuation exactly. No other visible words, even in the background. Use simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes on cream and green. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started any generation or spent credits.** I can’t give you a verified cost: the connected tools don’t expose a price estimator or your current credit balance. I won’t run a job just to discover its price.

Your requested timing would be:

| Time | Exact visible text |
|---|---|
| 0–3 seconds | Less scrolling. More doing. |
| 3–6 seconds | Plan your day in one place. |
| 6–9 seconds | Try DayNest today. |

The design would be silent, 16:9, with animated calendar and checkmark shapes on cream and green—and no other visible words.

### Cheapest and most reliable approach
**Use a basic motion-graphics editor rather than generative video.** Three text cards with simple shape animations can preserve the exact spelling, punctuation and timing. AI video generation may distort text or introduce unwanted words, potentially requiring paid retries.

- **Zero Magic Hour credits:** Build the full 9-second ad in a free editor using text, rectangles and checkmark shapes.
- **Smaller:** Export at 480p. That’s the free-plan video resolution here.
- **Shorter:** A 6-second version could use three 2-second scenes, though the text would have less reading time. Any credit savings would need a verified quote.
- **If using Magic Hour:** LTX 2.5 at 480p with audio disabled is a free-plan-compatible option, but I can’t verify its total credit charge here.

Also, Magic Hour’s guide says **commercial use requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase, or another paid arrangement**. That matters if you intend to publish this as an actual ad rather than a fictional mockup.

**My recommendation:** keep the full 9 seconds and use deterministic text-and-shape animation—no generation credits and much better control over your exact-wording requirement.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed
